statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I49.9
The procedure code is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events
